title: docs(types): the onViewChange reference row names the event, and three JSDoc blocks cite the dispatcher (objectui#10662)
body:
Fixes #10662
Clause-②: no

Docs and comments only. Two published texts told an author the wrong thing about the three view event-name keys. This PR corrects them to the declared contract and adds nothing beyond it.

## What changed

- **`content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, the `ViewSwitcherSchema` table.** The `onViewChange` row read "Expression or callback invoked on view change." It now follows the declared contract, which is the `onViewChange` describe in `packages/types/src/zod/views.zod.ts` and the pending `.changeset/6124-view-handler-keys-are-event-names.md`. The key is an event name, dispatched on `window` as a `CustomEvent` when the view changes, with `detail: { view }`. It is not a callback or a handler expression. The table keeps its column shape, and the type stays `string`. The other `onViewChange` row belongs to the `CalendarViewSchema` table (`function`, "Host-only"). That is a different key and it is untouched.
- **`packages/types/src/views.ts`, three docblocks.** The JSDoc of `ViewSwitcherSchema.onViewChange`, `FilterUISchema.onChange` and `SortUISchema.onChange` said each control read the key "as `new CustomEvent(schema.KEY, …)`". Since objectui#10646, that expression exists only in `notifyViewHandlerChannels` in `packages/plugin-view/src/viewHandlerChannels.ts`. Each docblock now names that function as the dispatcher and quotes the expression as the function writes it: `new CustomEvent(eventName, { detail })`. Each docblock still names its control file as the read site, because the control still reads the key and passes it to the dispatcher. Citations are by symbol and file only, with no line addresses.
- **`.changeset/10662-onviewchange-reference-row.md`**, with an empty frontmatter. `check-changeset-presence` guards every file under a released package's `src/`, so the comment-only edit to `views.ts` needs a declaration. The frontmatter declares no release. Built `@object-ui/types` output: all three new docblocks appear in `dist/views.d.ts`, and `dist/views.js` has none of them. `views.ts` is type-only, so no emitted JavaScript changes.

## Premise checks (on base `c659439b4`)

- **The row.** It read exactly as the card quotes it, inside the `ViewSwitcherSchema` table. The zod describe reads: "Event name dispatched on window when the view changes (detail: { view }) — an event NAME, not a callback or a handler expression". The new row takes its wording from that describe.
- **`FilterUISchema` / `SortUISchema` rows.** The API reference has neither table. Its `###` headings run from `SchemaNode` to `ViewSwitcherSchema` with neither name among them. A grep of `content/docs/` for either name hits only the component pages (`filter-ui.mdx`, `sort-ui.mdx`) and a bullet list in `guide/schema-overview.md`. As a control, the same grep for `ViewSwitcherSchema` hits. Nothing was added, because a new table is out of scope.
- **The three JSDoc citations.** The dispatch assumed all three cited `ViewSwitcher.tsx`, and that is only partly right. Each one cited its own control: `ViewSwitcher.tsx`, `FilterUI.tsx` and `SortUI.tsx`. The cited file still reads the key. What moved is the `new CustomEvent(...)` expression. Measured calls:
  - `ViewSwitcher`: `notifyViewHandlerChannels(onViewChange, schema.onViewChange, nextView, { view: nextView })`
  - `FilterUI`: `notifyViewHandlerChannels(onChange, schema.onChange, nextValues, { values: nextValues })`
  - `SortUI`: `notifyViewHandlerChannels(onChange, schema.onChange, nextSort, { sort: nextSort })`
  - The helper body: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(eventName, { detail }))`
- **Other citations re-checked.** The tombstone docblocks on the same three interfaces say "What the renderer DOES read off this node … (in `packages/plugin-view/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx`)", with twins for `FilterUI.tsx` and `SortUI.tsx`. They are still true: every key they list has a `schema.KEY` read in the named file. They are unchanged.
- **Mirror check.** The three zod describes in `views.zod.ts` carry no file citation, so there is nothing stale to report.
- **Same wording elsewhere.** "Expression or callback" occurs once across `content/docs/` and `packages/types/src/`: the row this PR fixes.

## Verification (final head `6a4ff3ca2`)

- Scoped build of the snippet/example closure, `turbo run build` with `--build-filter`: 35/35 tasks successful.
- `pnpm docs:check-links`: "Links are valid across 17 scan roots."
- `pnpm check:doc-types`: "Every documented component type is registered."
- `pnpm check:doc-snippets`: "Every covered documentation snippet compiles against the built types."
- `pnpm check:doc-fences`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:doc-examples`: "Every covered `@example` compiles, or fails exactly as its ledger row declares."
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check`: exit 0. The script name `type-check` is echoed in the output.
- Pins, run from the repo root with `pnpm exec vitest run`: `layout-default-jsdoc-7361`, the one types pin that reads `views.ts` source. Also `handler-keys-string-any-mirrors-7344`, `handler-keys-json-refusal-6124` and `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779`, plus the two plugin-view liveness pins for the dispatcher now cited (`handlerEventNameLiveness.6124`, `handlerEventNameThroughRenderer-10616`). Result: 6 files and 725 tests passed. No test snapshots or greps the edited JSDoc sentences. The four files that the dispatch's `ViewSwitcher.tsx` grep found use that path for other purposes.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: "0 new citation(s)". `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, with one empty declaration. `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`: "No test source names a pending changeset."
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` is report-only. It lists pending changesets that name `schema-reference.md` or `views.ts`. I read the ones that mention these keys or controls: `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779` (the `allowCreateView` / `viewActions` rows) and `calendar-view-schema-converge` (the calendar's own `onViewChange`). Neither is affected by this change. The rest are about other tables and members.
- Also run because they read the edited files: `check:spec-symbols`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:docs-route-closure` and `check:doc-example-ids` all exited 0.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the three paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- Not run locally: the full `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint`. CI runs them.

## Acceptance notes

- The component pages `view-switcher.mdx`, `filter-ui.mdx` and `sort-ui.mdx` show `onViewChange?: string;` / `onChange?: string;` in their interface fences, without a word on what the string is. They are not wrong, and they are outside this card's file surface.
- The pending `.changeset/6124-view-handler-keys-are-event-names.md` shows the dispatch as `new CustomEvent(schema.onViewChange, { detail: { view } })`. That still describes the behaviour correctly and does not cite a source file, so it is left as written.
- `packages/types/src/zod/views.zod.ts` is not touched.
